build_LTXLatentUpsamplePipeline: build an LTXLatentUpsamplePipeline with a VAE and latent upsampler model for video latent upscaling
run_pipeline_call: run the pipeline __call__ method to upscale video latents with optional AdaIN, tone mapping, and VAE decoding
prepare_video_latents: prepare video latents by encoding frames through the VAE and normalizing with learned mean and standard deviation
apply_adain_filter: apply AdaIN filter to blend latent statistics from a reference tensor into the upscaled latents
apply_tone_mapping: apply sigmoid-based tone mapping to compress the dynamic range of latent values for regularization
